scientific_question: Which prespecified pathway polygenic scores are associated with later clinical decline through a prespecified imaging marker?

cohort.independence_statement: ADNI3 subjects may overlap the earlier method-development screen; the confirmation endpoints were not used to fit or tune the final generator policy.

allowed_uses: diagnostic testing of the analysis implementation
forbidden_uses: selection of confirmation outcomes using association strength
selection of confirmation candidates using hidden confirmation statistics
retuning after confirmation outcomes are revealed

confirmation_data.outcome_direction: annualized_decline_score is oriented so that positive values indicate worsening

pathway_exposures.selection_rule: one available score per pathway; prefer p1em03, then p5em02, then lexical score_name

candidate_universe.construction: Cartesian product of selected pathway exposure, imaging marker, and confirmation outcome
candidate_universe.exclusions_after_freeze: Only prespecified non-estimability or minimum-sample exclusions are allowed; excluded candidates retain their original rank and count as unsuccessful for generator metrics.

statistics.scientific_reporting_rule: Global-FDR results determine confirmatory scientific claims; family-FDR results evaluate search efficiency and are explicitly labelled benchmark discoveries.

generator_evaluation.baseline_rule: Each baseline produces and freezes a complete static SearchPolicy before confirmation outcomes are accessed.
generator_evaluation.neurodiscovery_rule: NeuroDiscovery freezes its initial policy before access, then commits each next batch ordering before outcomes for that batch are revealed.
generator_evaluation.invalid_candidate_rule: Invalid, duplicate, missing, or non-estimable candidates consume their generated or ranked slot and are scored as unsuccessful.
generator_evaluation.primary_metric: area under the family-FDR discovery-recall curve over prespecified budgets
secondary_metrics: experiments required to reach each attainable recall target
generator_evaluation.comparison: paired across the ten prespecified run indices with percentile bootstrap confidence intervals and paired randomization P values

freeze_semantics.temporal_kg_freeze_definition: Not applicable: this is not a hindcasting experiment and no historical publication cutoff is imposed.
freeze_semantics.kg_snapshot_pinning_definition: The current canonical KG and claim-store bytes are hash-pinned for reproducibility.
freeze_semantics.initial_ranking_freeze_definition: Every method commits an initial SearchPolicy before hidden confirmation outcomes are evaluated.
freeze_semantics.sequential_batch_commit_definition: For NeuroDiscovery, each adaptive next-batch ranking is committed using only outcomes from earlier executed batches.
